title: Resolve market geography before contextual benchmarks
reason:
User customers, orders and suppliers carry a country label/code, locality, postcode and event date. Proposed reviewed aliases/codes lead to territory and WDI economy+indicator+year; contextual locality leads to GeoNames feature/admin. Ask which locations match confidently, how customer/order counts compare per capita, and how growth compares with economic context. Visuals: map,time series,unmatched grid. Country labels and local FK paths span Chinook,Northwind,Sakila,AdventureWorks,Pubs. Raw fixture subsets are not representative market share. Missing: historical code/alias policy,aggregate filtering,measured match rates and geometry crosswalk. Count-based comparisons avoid invented money currencies.

Phase 2 context reviewed: scenario; directly attached assertion dispositions are enumerated in p2-coverage.json. Member/dependency IDs preserved. Each unresolved/rejected mapping, source rights and temporal/domain gap remains a readiness prerequisite; no portfolio selection or executable bundle acceptance.
practical_value: Proposed connected bundle; identity, temporal, legal and match-rate review required. Not selected or implemented.
showcase_value: Named visualisations support the questions; practical joinability dominates.
